top_signals.title: Hong Kong Homebuyers Left Cold by Prices in Far-Flung Tech Hub
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong’s ambitious plan to create a technology hub near the mainland Chinese border faces an early test after the first residential sales in its Northern Metropolis got off to a middling start, highlighting the hurdles to turning the area into a new economic engine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
